# outputs/drivers/wind/ — Wind–MHW Driver Analysis

Home of the project headline: **78–84% of BoB MHW events occurred during anomalously weak surface winds** (North 83.7%, Central 77.5%, South 82.1%; **95/117 = 81.2%** overall).

## Contents

| Item | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `{region}_wind_mhw_analysis.csv` | Wind 30/21/14/7 d before, during, change, weak/strong flag |
| `{region}_wind_climatology_analysis.csv` | Event wind vs DOY climatology |
| `{region}_event_plots/` | One figure per event (117 total) |

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/wind_mhw_analysis.py`, `wind_climatology_analysis.py`, `wind_mhw_summary.py`  
(input series from `extract_regional_wind.py` → `outputs/timeseries/{region}_wind.csv`)

## Classification

**Weak wind event:** mean wind during the event is **below** the regional climatological mean for the same calendar window.

## Upstream / Downstream

Timeseries wind + catalogue → these tables/plots → master catalogue, ML features, publication weak-wind figure.

## Notes

Wind extracted over **80–100°E** while SST regions use **85–95°E** (documented; do not silently “fix”).
